blind.description: A set of five stylized hardcover books arranged upright between two carved classical scroll-shaped bookends. The books have alternating dark green, brown, and ochre leather-like bindings with gilded spine ribs, and cream-colored page tops visible. The bookends are sculpted in a warm sandstone or beige material with decorative volutes. All surfaces are clean, fully textured, and solid with no floating or broken geometry, sitting completely flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A horizontal bar composed of five rounded book tops displaying cream page edges flanked by two beige rectangular bookend caps, casting a rectangular blocky shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/12 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 5-6 inches tall), and about 8-10 inches wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.47x off the catalog (1.3 x 0.4 ft)
